prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: original square 1024x1024 World of Warcraft addon project logo for Yours Truly, personal letters from the people whose quests the player completed.
Primary request: a single large sealed envelope made from thick folded warm cream parchment, its broad triangular flap and layered folded edges clearly visible. A substantial glossy-but-painted deep vermilion-red wax seal at the centre holds the flap closed, with a simple embossed feather impression, no letter or rune. A thin warm golden braided cord wraps the envelope and passes beneath the seal. One large ivory feather quill with a richly gilded nib rests diagonally behind the envelope, rising above one corner and extending slightly below the opposite corner, its silhouette fully readable. The envelope and the oversized red seal are the two main forms, the feather a clear supporting gesture. Slight three-quarter top-down view, warm parchment and amber edges, a little honest wear, deep wine-red wax shadows and bright orange-gold rim highlights. This should feel like a treasured letter from Azeroth, personal and substantial, not a modern messaging app. No writing, address or stamp on the envelope.
Style and medium: a cohesive family of original World of Warcraft addon inventory icons. Rich hand-painted fantasy game illustration, bold angular brushwork visible across every surface, chunky slightly exaggerated forms, thick sculpted faceted yellow-gold highlights, deep burnt-orange metal shadows, saturated jewel colours, exceptionally clear silhouette. Same illustrator's family as a massive golden keyring with turquoise and emerald keys, a gold-rimmed parchment speech bubble, a gold-cornered magical tome, and a blue steel battle shield. Painterly textured artwork, never a smooth realistic product render. A few large forms readable at 32-64 pixels.
Backdrop: opaque full-bleed deep inky midnight-navy square with restrained blue painterly vignette and quiet near-black corners. No outer frame or rounded app tile. Centred hero object occupies approximately 85% of square, with all edges visible and a small dark margin.
Constraints: one finished square icon only. No text, readable writing, letters, initials, numbers, wordmark, watermark, mockup, UI screenshot, logo sheet, interface bars, charts, photorealism, flat vector graphics, glossy 3D rendering, excessive filigree, scenery, character portrait, faction-specific crest, scattered sparkles or oversized magical aura.
